newsitem.title: DUBAI: Arab man held in UAE over murder of German woman.
newsitem.headline: Arab man held in UAE over murder of German woman.

text.p: Dubai police arrested an Arab man in connection with the murder on Saturday of a 24-year-old German woman, local newspapers reported on Wednesday.
They quoted police sources as saying that the suspect, who they did not identify, was arrested 48 hours after the crime at the victim's home.
The woman, named as Christina Klossek from Sondershausen, had been stabbed seven times in her chest and neck.
Police said they had seized a knife used in the killing. No motive for the crime had been established.

German consulate officials told Gulf News daily that, Klosseck, who came to Dubai in the Gulf state of the United Arab Emirates two or three months ago, worked at a German bakery in the seaside district of Jumeira.
Consulate officials were not available to confirm the report.
